Llama-3.2-3B benefit and gpt-6-luna null remain together; current SHA-256 archives differ from earlier Ed25519 stages; 39 proof-model files, dated 5,171 tests/92 releases, live AgentDojo utility cost and deterministic utility-under-attack labels remain scoped. NanoMatch distinguishes expected ID lookup from tree-based cancellation and standalone pool evidence. SentinelFlow parser-only workload, fixed detector/rule-option boundary and historical test scope are retained. ECRSM article explicitly records missing attachment, SSE/perf transport and privileged lab deployment. SimurghForge limits CLI dependencies, routing/format pairs, 50 files and 1–8 jobs. Mehr limits latency to desktop-JVM engine checks and avoids network-attestation claims.

Syllabus 1,343/155 is dated to the successful test job and separate failed security job; public auth exceptions, independent affiliation, co-maintainer role and extractor roadmap are explicit. GitSwitch storage/reference cleanup and multiple providers are qualified. Nexus token visibility, key-required/conditional encryption and REST chat are explicit. Divan application/edge privacy, verified-cache readiness and engineering versus human review are distinct.

Key results, null results, benchmark scopes and operational limits agree with canonical data and pinned reports; no stale private-Zurvan, universal zero-cloud/hallucination, current 218-test, old Electron-33 or old overall-green 503/92 headline remains.

The route enumerates every Project with description/full description, stack, features, security/limitations and proof, and all seven article summaries with separate Published/Updated dates. Static current Simurgh and author facts agree with source snapshots. This is summary coverage, not a claim that every complete article body is emitted.

Software DOI 21737792 is attached to SoftwareSourceCode through sameAs/DOI identifier; the three Simurgh publication records retain their distinct scholarly DOI identities. Original DOI articles have no artificial site-revision dateModified and stay English. Current public Zurvan omits private access conditions; the private UI branch remains covered with an explicit fixture.

Expected June 2027 graduation, online final session and December 2026 placement availability remain distinct. Person affiliation does not claim graduation. Professional Gmail and security-reporting Outlook roles are retained; no phone is added to machine/schema data or review artifacts.

Both supplied originals, five research PDFs and the earlier authorised phone-free résumé copy match their recorded hashes. Later public repository facts update derived web text; source PDFs are intentionally not factually rewritten.
